title: Demon Analysis
paragraphs: “N-Na~no?”
As we arrived at what seemed to be the ruins of a castle, Rival let out a strange sound. Father looked concerned.
“What’s wrong, Gaelion?”
“I’m not sure… the high density of magic and pollution is making my senses dull. I felt something that seemed like a dragon’s presence, but I can’t imagine one being in a place like this.”
“It might be best not to dismiss that possibility. We have no idea what might come out.”
“Even so…”
Ren and Itsuki looked relieved as they glanced at the oasis near the ruins.
“With this, we don’t have to worry even if the sun comes up.”
“Yes, the water is free of toxins, and there doesn’t seem to be any contamination.”
“Ah… I never thought I’d be this happy just to see water.”
“Ren can’t swim, after all…”
“I-I can swim!”
While having that conversation, we took down the attacking demons one after another and made our way into the ruins. It looks like there’s a castle deeper inside.
“Could that be Prado Castle?”
“Possibly. But… I hate to say it, but it looks like an ancient demon lord’s fortress.”
“Yeah. It’s got the vibe of an old retro game.”
“A castle of demons in the ruins of a desert nation…”
“Feels like the setup for an expedition team.”
Father and the others nearly tripped over themselves at my comment. What a strong reaction. Did I say something that strange?
“I mean, I brought it up, but Motoyasu’s comments just made it feel even more like that!”
“It’s the Naofumi Expedition Team!”
“Stop that! It’s embarrassing! I won’t be the last one to enter after the cameraman!”
“Are you trying to say it looks staged?”
“I won’t deny it. But couldn’t you phrase it a little better?”
“Let’s just call it Demon Castle Prado.”
“Even that’s a bit risky, Kuro. It sounds like some kind of action game.”
This… nostalgic atmosphere of a ruined desert city… If it weren’t for the ominous vibes, this might actually be a nice date spot with Filo. Thinking that, we proceeded toward the castle.
“Impressive. Watching creatures that seem like infamous demons from history get annihilated by the heroes in seconds is quite the sight.”
Along the way, the doctor was analyzing the demons. As expected, he’s quite useful in situations like these.
“If devout believers saw this, they’d probably be weeping with joy.”
Father and the others had somewhat complicated expressions. Well, considering the precedent set by the Three Heroes Church, they don’t have the best impression of religion.
“By the way, do you think this will be useful for your research?”
“It’s a bit difficult. I hate to say it, but I don’t really want to call demons monsters. Their body structure is pretty random too.”
“Huh…”
“They don’t communicate, but I thought they had intelligence and worked together… but something feels off. Watching the heroes take them down makes it clearer.”
“What’s different?”
“Well… to put it simply, they’re like golems. Golems are magical constructs created artificially and follow simple commands.”
“I’ve fought golems before.”

“They occasionally show up in labyrinths. To get back on topic, I thought demons were living creatures, but watching the heroes fight them… they seem complex at first glance, but their actions are surprisingly simple. There’s no emotional fluctuation. They only appear to get angry, and not a single one shows fear. No hesitation. They analyze the situation quickly, but there’s no adaptation. This behavior is similar to what happens before an overpowered golem goes berserk.”
“So… what does that mean?”
We all tilted our heads at the doctor’s explanation. But Ren seemed to catch on and clapped his hands in realization.
“Ah, I see. So that’s it.”
“Ren, did you figure something out?”
“Yeah. I’ve figured out what they resemble. Itsuki, Motoyasu, and Naofumi should have a clue too.”
“Is that true?”
“Yeah. The behavior of these demons… is similar to monsters in a game. Basically, they’re like simple AI controlled by a computer.”

Itsuki also looked like he had a realization after hearing Ren’s words. …Now that he mentioned it, the demons’ combat patterns were similar to enemies from Emerald Online. The slight intelligence they showed was also similar to the more complex attacks used by boss monsters. What does this mean?
“Ah… I get it now. So they’re behaving like the enemies from Ren’s Brave Star Online and Itsuki’s Dimension Wave, right? Motoyasu, is it the same for you?”
“Yes. They are certainly similar.”
“Yeah, I hate to admit it, but if someone pointed it out, I’d have to agree.”
“Well, we can’t make a blanket statement about all of them. In the case of succubus types, their goal might be to manipulate people’s hearts, so they might show signs of fear.”
Ah, the pig type. I’ve been incinerating them the moment they get close.
“Those are the demons that expose their nude bodies without speaking, right?”
“Naofumi absolutely can’t go near them!”
“You have no right to say that. If anything, you’re the same kind.”
“That’s not true!”
Rival’s claims left Itsuki and Father exasperated. Even I was exasperated. He’s on the same level as that pig. Always in heat, just like him.
“Gaelion only wants Naofumi.”
“You have no credibility when you’re the one who was lusting after the Filolials.”
“That’s the spear hero’s fault!”
“Now, now… Either way, the demons of this world aren’t monsters but magical constructs. Their structure is fundamentally different from living creatures.”

“Yes. But still… each of their materials is of such high quality that I’m sure plenty of people would be drooling over them. If we bring them back, we could make a fortune, and if used properly, they could even lead to technological advancements.”
“Things that can be made from demon materials, huh…”
“There might be a recipe somewhere. Strengthening our forces… outfitting the villagers wouldn’t be a bad idea.”
“I want cool equipment!”
Kuro-chan said with sparkling eyes. Indeed. If we brought back the materials and had them made into equipment, we might be able to create something that Kuro-chan would like.
“Hmm?”
“Even the simple drop items seem to be of high quality.”

Father was taking out swords for Sakura-chan from the drop items. There were also staffs, which Big Sister was using. Their friend had taken claws and was swinging them skillfully. I think they used to use a dagger before… Did they switch weapons?
There were also armor pieces, so as we progressed, I could feel us getting stronger. And with all that, we finally stood before the castle. The gate was tightly shut.
“To open it…”
There wasn’t exactly a hidden path, but there was a place where we could descend into the moat.
“Should we just jump over it to save time?”
“It looks like there’s a barrier over the top of the gate.”
“Then I’ll smash through it.”
I took position in front of the gate. Perhaps I should blast it away with Brionac?
“There’s no meaning to the pride or thrill of conquering when it comes to real life.”
“Well… that’s how it is.”
“We don’t have a choice.”
“Then, victory through preemptive strike! Brionac X!”
I channeled my power and fired Brionac at the gate. However, a barrier formed to resist the attack with a resounding bash.
“Whoa… Well, considering how tightly this place is protected, that result was expected.”
“Yeah. It’s going to be a hassle, but we need to find a way through—”
“Here I go! Take this!!”

I stomped forward, putting all my strength into it. The barrier intercepted the light of Brionac, forming what looked like multiple layers of magical sigils in an attempt to protect the gate. Such an annoying resistance. But for someone like me now, this barrier was flimsier than paper.
“…This is really strict.”
“But it looks like we can break through. Let’s—”
Before Itsuki could finish, the barrier shattered with a loud noise under the high-output power of my Brionac.
